biotools.summary: mettannotator is a Nextflow pipeline for prokaryotic genome annotation, identifying coding and noncoding regions, predicting protein functions, and delineating gene clusters. It generates a GFF file with results from multiple tools and is available on WorkflowHub and GitHub.
